name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport PR began during his university years, volunteering at local karting events near Shanghai. He quickly discovered a knack for crafting compelling narratives and connecting with audiences, which led him to pursue a degree in Communications. After graduating, Wei honed his skills at a smaller motorsport marketing firm, managing social media campaigns and securing media coverage for regional racing series.

Wei is known for his data-driven approach to PR, meticulously tracking engagement metrics and tailoring his strategies to maximize impact. His passion lies in bridging the gap between technical aspects of racing and the wider public, making complex engineering feats accessible and exciting. He’s particularly adept at building relationships with both established journalists and rising influencers in the motorsport world.

What sets Wei apart is his ability to seamlessly blend traditional PR methods with innovative digital strategies. He’s always experimenting with new platforms and formats to reach a broader audience, ensuring Inter Europol Competition stays ahead of the curve in the ever-evolving media landscape.
